# Swagger UI assets

These files are copied unchanged from `swagger-ui-dist` version **5.32.15**:

- `swagger-ui-bundle.js` and `swagger-ui.css`: Swagger UI runtime and stylesheet.
- `favicon-32x32.png`: page icon.
- `LICENSE`, `NOTICE`, and `swagger-ui-bundle.js.LICENSE.txt`: license and
  third-party notices, retained with the distributed assets.

Source: <https://www.npmjs.com/package/swagger-ui-dist/v/5.32.15>

Swagger UI is licensed under Apache-2.0. The page uses these local files, so
serving the documentation does not require npm or a CDN connection.
